local scn, done = ...
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local start, ang = Vector(700, -600, -143.6), Angle(20, 90, 0)
local calls, t = {}, -30
local function rec(ent, kind, extra)
  local r = { t = t, ent = ent.parity_tag or "?", kind = kind, cur = CurTime() }
  if extra then for k, v in pairs(extra) do r[k] = v end end
  calls[#calls+1] = r
end
local ENT = { Type = "anim", Base = "base_anim" }
function ENT:Initialize()
  self:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
  self:PhysicsInit(SOLID_VPHYSICS) self:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS) self:SetSolid(SOLID_VPHYSICS)
  self:SetUseType(self.parity_usetype or CONTINUOUS_USE)
  local phys = self:GetPhysicsObject() if IsValid(phys) then phys:EnableMotion(false) end
  rec(self, "Initialize")
end
function ENT:Think()
  rec(self, "Think", { next = self.parity_next })
  if self.parity_next then self:NextThink(CurTime() + self.parity_next) return true end
end
function ENT:Touch(e) rec(self, "Touch", { other = e:GetClass() }) end
function ENT:StartTouch(e) rec(self, "StartTouch", { other = e:GetClass() }) end
function ENT:EndTouch(e) rec(self, "EndTouch", { other = e:GetClass() }) end
function ENT:PhysicsCollide(d, phys) rec(self, "PhysicsCollide", { other = IsValid(d.HitEntity) and d.HitEntity:GetClass() or "", speed = d.Speed }) end
function ENT:Use(activator, caller, usetype, value) rec(self, "Use", { usetype = usetype, value = value, act = IsValid(activator) and activator:GetClass() or "" }) end
function ENT:OnRemove() rec(self, "OnRemove") end
function ENT:OnTakeDamage(dmg) rec(self, "OnTakeDamage", { dmg = dmg:GetDamage() }) end
scripted_ents.Register(ENT, "parity_sent")
local function make(tag, pos, next, usetype)
  local e = ents.Create("parity_sent") e.parity_tag = tag e.parity_next = next e.parity_usetype = usetype
  e:SetPos(pos) rec(e, "pre-Spawn") e:Spawn() rec(e, "post-Spawn") e:Activate() rec(e, "post-Activate")
  return e
end
-- A: default Think cadence, continuous use, in front of the bot; B: NextThink 0.1; C: SIMPLE_USE, D: ONOFF_USE
local A = make("A", Vector(700, -550, -123.6), nil, CONTINUOUS_USE)
local B = make("B", Vector(400, -200, -123.6), 0.1, nil)
local C = make("C", Vector(500, -200, -123.6), 0.5, SIMPLE_USE)
local D = make("D", Vector(600, -200, -123.6), nil, ONOFF_USE)
local crate
local function held(tk)
  if tk >= 100 and tk < 105 then return IN_USE end
  if tk >= 150 and tk < 155 then return IN_USE end
  if tk >= 200 and tk < 205 then return IN_USE end
  return 0
end
local target = A
hook.Add("StartCommand", "parity_sent", function(ply, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement() cmd:SetButtons(held(t)) cmd:SetViewAngles(ang)
end)
hook.Add("SetupMove", "parity_sent", function(ply, mv, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  if t < 0 then mv:SetOrigin(start) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0)) mv:SetButtons(0) else mv:SetButtons(held(t)) end
end)
hook.Add("Think", "parity_sent", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == 30 then
    crate = ents.Create("prop_physics") crate:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
    crate:SetPos(Vector(400, -200, -40)) crate:Spawn() crate:Activate()
  end
  if t == 140 then A:SetPos(Vector(300, -200, -123.6)) C:SetPos(Vector(700, -550, -123.6)) end
  if t == 190 then C:SetPos(Vector(500, -200, -123.6)) D:SetPos(Vector(700, -550, -123.6)) end
  if t == 240 then A:Remove() end
  if t == 250 then B:TakeDamage(5, bot, bot) end
  if t == 280 then
    for _, h in ipairs({ "Think", "StartCommand", "SetupMove" }) do hook.Remove(h, "parity_sent") end
    local pos = IsValid(crate) and crate:GetPos() or nil
    for _, e in ipairs({ B, C, D }) do if IsValid(e) then e:Remove() end end
    if IsValid(crate) then crate:Remove() end
    done({ calls = calls, crate = pos, tickrate = 1 / engine.TickInterval() })
  end
end)
return "async"
